topic: The Möbius Strip as a Non-Orientable Topological Surface

R: A 3D polygon mesh of the Möbius strip rendered using the Painter's Algorithm
Faces colored with a teal-to-sky-blue gradient mapped to the u parameter
Depth shading simulating a diffuse light source
Numeric overlays showing the current rotX and rotY viewing angles
T: Clicking and dragging horizontally on the canvas updates rotY, rotating the strip around the vertical axis
Clicking and dragging vertically updates rotX, tilting the strip forward or backward
Releasing the mouse locks the current orientation
srtc.C: No matter how the strip is rotated, a continuous path along its surface always returns to the starting point in a mirrored orientation, demonstrating the strip's single-sidedness.
